subject: Post-call: token volumes, model mix & budget alignment
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Reynolds <alexr@finlytics.com>, Bethany Cole <procurement@finlytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-04-07T15:08:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap + numbers request (token mix / budget)

Alex / Bethany — thanks for the time today. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can size a proposal that hits your $/1M-token target.

Call highlights:
- Use case: Conversational insights for customer support (chat assistant + post-chat embedding signals + rerank for KB retrieval).
- Primary KPIs: 60% reduction in average handle time, 30% deflection for Tier-1, and more precise doc retrieval.
- Technical constraints: latency SLO ~300ms p95 for chat generation, embeddings offline and batched, rerank latency tolerant (~1s).

What I need from you to finish the pricing sketch:
1) Monthly token volume (estimate) by model type: chat messages (in/out tokens), embeddings (docs/month), rerank calls. If you only have averages, that’s fine — ballpark ranges work.
2) Target monthly budget range (band) or target $/1M tokens you want us to hit so we can recommend model variants / quantization profiles.
3) Any regulatory constraints (data residency / retention) that would move this to Dedicated or Private.

Preliminary model mix (from the demo flow we discussed) — please confirm or correct: 
- Chat (assistant): 70% of token volume — active user conversations, avg prompt+response 1.4k tokens/session.
- Embeddings (offline): 20% — vectorizing historical transcripts and new docs, avg doc ~800 tokens.
- Rerank (online): 10% — batch retrieval then rerank top-K, avg rerank request ~400 tokens.

Unit economics / targets (example):
- If target is $25 / 1M tokens, best fit will likely be a mixed model approach: cheaper chat variant for most queries + higher-quality variant for escalations.
- We can suggest token-level pricing and show projected monthly $ by applying the model split to your volumes.

Attached: redwood_pricing_sheet_Q2.pdf (pricing bands), finlytics_usage_projection_v1.xlsx (empty template) and a starter MAP.

Next steps proposed:
- Alex: send ballpark monthly volumes by Tue 4/9.
- We'll return a 2-tier proposal (hosted vs. dedicated) with per-model unit costs and an expected monthly cost breakdown by 4/10.
- If budget is constrained, we’ll prioritize embedding quantization + caching and a cheaper chat baseline.

Thanks — Sergio

-- 
Sergio Alvarez
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Alex Reynolds <alexr@finlytics.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Bethany Cole <procurement@finlytics.com>
Date: 2026-04-08T09:13:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + numbers request (token mix / budget)

Thanks Sergio — appreciate the clear recap. Quick numbers from our side (very rough):

Estimated steady-state monthly volumes (month 6 after launch):
- Chat (assistant): ~1.2B tokens/month (this is user prompts + model responses). We expect bursty patterns (support spikes).
- Embeddings (offline): ~18M tokens/month (batch vectorization of historical tickets + daily incremental docs).
- Rerank: ~6M tokens/month (we trigger rerank only for escalation flows).

Budget: our procurement team is targeting ~$10k–$18k/month initially (we could go higher after proof-of-value). As a quick unit target, we'd like to see something around $12–18 / 1M tokens as a blended benchmark — but we care about accuracy too; if the quality delta is material we can flex.

Regulatory: US-only data residency for PII, standard SOC2 required. No air-gap required.

I'll loop in Marissa and Monica if you need technical follow-ups. Happy to schedule a deep-dive on volumes.

— Alex
Alex Reynolds
Head of Product, Finlytics
alexr@finlytics.com | +1 (646) 555-0123

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Reynolds <alexr@finlytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Bethany Cole <procurement@finlytics.com>
Date: 2026-04-08T11:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + numbers request (token mix / budget)

Alex — perfect, that range is helpful. A couple of clarifying points so our proposal models the right cost/quality tradeoffs: 

1) Chat token composition: the 1.2B number — is that total tokens (prompt+response)? If you can split prompt vs. response ratio (or give avg tokens per message) that helps. For sizing, we assumed ~55/45 prompt/response.

2) Embeddings: when you say 18M tokens/month — is that mostly one-off historical backfill (big upfront) plus small steady ingestion, or steady continuous vectorization? If big backfill in month 1, cost profile will be lumpy.

3) Rerank: confirm avg top-K and whether you plan to run rerank for every retrieval or only when similarity below threshold.

Based on the numbers you gave, here’s a starter unit-econ sketch (blended for hosted model options):
- Baseline chat variant (cheaper float/8-bit quant): assumed $16 / 1M tokens -> monthly chat cost: ~$19,200
- Higher-quality chat alpha for escalations (20% of chat tokens): assumed $48 / 1M tokens -> incremental cost: ~$11,520
- Embeddings (quantized): assumed $9 / 1M tokens -> monthly embeddings: ~$162
- Rerank (specialized reranker): assumed $30 / 1M tokens -> monthly rerank: ~$180

Blended estimate at those assumptions: ~$31.1k/month. That’s above your $10k–$18k band. Options to hit target ~$15k/month:
- Move 60% of chat queries to a cheaper chat variant + reserve higher-quality only for escalation triggers (reduces high-quality chat share from 20% to 5%).
- Enable aggressive prefix/KV caching for frequent prompts (saves ~10–25% tokens depending on repetition).
- Apply 4-bit quantization on embeddings and rerank to reduce unit costs further (may be acceptable since embeddings are used for retrieval).

Can you confirm whether a blended target of ~$12–18 / 1M tokens is a hard cap or just a preference? If it’s a hard cap, we’ll produce a variant plan with specific model names/quantization levels and an expected quality delta per variant.

Next steps (proposed):
- Marissa/Monica: if you can take the finlytics_usage_projection_v1.xlsx and drop in any prompt/response averages and a monthly volume profile, we’ll run two pricing scenarios (hosted mixed-variant + Dedicated reserved) and share a MAP.
- Alex/Bethany: if $12–18 / 1M tokens is a hard budget cap, say ``HARD_CAP`` in reply and we’ll prioritize hitting that pricing target in option A.

I’ll prepare a model mix proposal with explicit per-model token split, expected monthly $, and quality notes by 2026-04-10.

Thanks — Sergio

--
Sergio Alvarez
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-04-09T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + numbers request (token mix / budget)

Looping in with a quick internal note and next steps from Redwood: 

Internal ask for pricing model/PS handoff:
- Monica: can you validate the per-model unit assumptions Sergio used (16/48/9/30 per 1M tokens) and run a sensitivity for alt quantization (4-bit/8-bit) so we can show a low/high for hosted?
- Monica/SE team: produce a short slide (1 page) that states expected quality delta if we push chat baseline to cheaper variant vs. keeping high-quality everywhere. We’ll use that in the commercial deck.

External next steps (copied): Alex/Bethany — thanks for the numbers. We’ll produce two proposals:
A) Hosted mixed-variant (aim to hit ~$15k/mo blended) — includes caching + 60/40 cheap/quality chat split and 4-bit embeddings.
B) Dedicated reserved capacity (3-6 month commitment) — higher up-front but lower unit $ and better data isolation for PII.

Timing: we’ll aim to share both options and a MAP by Friday 4/10. If you want a technical session before then to validate prompt sizes, we can block 30 minutes tomorrow 4/10 morning PT.

Marissa
VP, Growth | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
